findings.description: The removed `_read_file_bytes` helper saved the file position and seeked back after reading. The direct `value.read()` calls leave the file cursor at EOF. If the same UploadFile is read again (for example when the form is parsed a second time, or another dependency or field uses the same upload), it gets empty bytes. This is a regression from the previous behavior.
findings.suggestion: Restore `_read_file_bytes`, or otherwise save the position before `read()` and `await file.seek(position)` afterwards in both places.
findings.title: UploadFile position no longer restored after reading bytes
